# SpaceAutoBattler

> A 3D deterministic space auto-battler simulation: pure simulation logic separated from rendering and UI. This repository contains the simulation core, renderer, configuration, tests, and build scripts used to run, test, and build the project for local development and CI.

This llms.txt file lists prioritized navigation targets for LLMs and contributors to quickly understand the repository layout, purpose, and where to find authoritative information (design, configuration, tests, and runtime scripts).

## Documentation

- [Main README](README.md): Primary project overview, architecture, quick start, controls, and development guidelines.
- [IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE](docs/IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md): Design notes and implementation guidance for core subsystems.
- [CURRENT_STATUS_NEXT_STEPS](docs/CURRENT_STATUS_NEXT_STEPS.md): Developer-facing status and next tasks.
- [AI_Review_and_Improvements](docs/AI_Review_and_Improvements.md): Notes about AI improvements and behavior changes.
- [threejs-libraries](docs/threejs-libraries.md): References and choices for Three.js libraries and helpers.
- [shipIndex](docs/shipIndex.md): Index of ship-related documentation and references.
- [RESEARCH_GPT5_COOKBOOK](docs/RESEARCH_GPT5_COOKBOOK.md): Research notes valuable for model-driven changes.

SpaceAutoBattler — Quick LLM Navigation Guide

This file gives a concise, up-to-date map for contributors and LLMs to find the most authoritative documentation, high-value source files, and test locations in the repository.

Top-level goals
- Focus on the pure simulation core (deterministic game logic and AI) separated from the renderer.
- Keep changes safe and test-driven: unit tests in `test/vitest/` validate simulation behavior without rendering.

Documentation (high-value)
- `README.md` — project overview, quick start, and development commands.
- `docs/CURRENT_STATUS_NEXT_STEPS.md` — active work, blockers, and next tasks.
- `docs/AI_Review_and_Improvements.md` — notes on AI behavior, optimization targets, and rationale.

Key source locations
- `src/core/` — simulation core (AI, physics, game state). Primary area for logic changes.
  - `src/core/gameState.ts` — canonical `GameState` type and state transition helpers (single source of truth for runtime state).
  - `src/core/ai/` — AI modules (controller, steering, intent, targeting, spatial helpers). Hotpaths for perf work.
  - `src/core/physics.ts` — deterministic physics and movement helpers.
- `src/types/` — TypeScript types used across the codebase (including `GameState`).
- `src/config/` — All balance and runtime configuration (entities, behavior, physics, renderer). Prefer changing config over code when tuning behavior.

Testing and verification
- Unit tests (fast): `npm test` / `test/vitest/` — primary validation for simulation logic.
- Typecheck: `npm run typecheck` (fast) — prevents type regressions.
- Build: `npm run build` / `npm run build-standalone` — quick bundle verification.

Tooling & scripts
- `package.json` — scripts (serve, build, test, typecheck).
- `scripts/` — helper scripts (generating memory files, validators, builds).

Performance hotspots (where LLMs often help)
- `src/core/ai/controller.ts` — `updateShipAI` hot path; careful, atomic edits required with tests after each change.
- `src/core/ai/steering.ts`, `src/core/ai/intent.ts`, `src/core/ai/targeting.ts` — priority targets for math/sqrt/hypot reductions.
- `src/utils/vector3.ts` and `src/core/spatial.*` — geometry helpers and spatial queries.

Conventions & safety
- Edit only TypeScript under `src/` (do not edit `dist/` or built artifacts).
- Preserve determinism: use the seeded RNG utilities when needed and avoid non-deterministic operations in simulation code paths.
- Keep changes atomic and test-driven: run unit tests and typecheck after each change.

Where to start for common tasks
- Add/adjust AI behavior: `src/core/ai/*` + tests in `test/vitest/ai-*.spec.ts`.
- Fix a failing test: run `npx vitest` and open the failing test file under `test/vitest/`.
- Performance micro-optimizations: search for `Math.hypot`/`Math.sqrt` in `src/core/ai/` and replace with squared-distance gating where safe.

Governance & notes
- Maintainer: `deadronos` — main branch is `main`, active development on `dev`.
- Follow the repository's Copilot/agent guidance in `.github/copilot-instructions.md` for automated edits.

If you need a tailored quickstart or a minimal patch (tests + typecheck run), open an issue or ask for an automated change.
